message:
test(safety): a final judgement needs the producer's end, a real EOF and the OFF lines in that text; fatal's startup faults are judged whole before anything is deleted (test-injection-finding r8, Codex a8b3407 N1 N2)

N1: e2e_read_to_end tells a confirmed end of output (0 bytes, or ERROR_BROKEN_PIPE) from any
other read failure (kept with its code, after however many bytes) and from a reader its owner
cut; a join is not an EOF. e2e_final_file refuses a missing log and a read error part-way.
E2eInjectionMonitor::Finalize(producerEnded, final) judges e2e_final_verdict: the end AND the EOF
AND both OFF lines in that final text AND no contradiction -- otherwise INVALID. The job is
borrowed: the four pipe harnesses now close it after Finalize, and the monitor drops it at
Finalize / destruction (an abandoned launch is said NOT confirmed instead of acting on a closed
handle). The four log-file harnesses pass e2e_final_file.

N2: fatal's --prelogin worker is judged before its logs go (e2e_startup_fault_verdict: power OFF
whole, no contradiction, the input line allowed absent and said so; its end confirmed) and a
refusal ends the whole test INVALID with the worker's unconfirmed end passed on. std / winrt use
the same verdict; the normal control needs both lines; every case's final read is checked.

Runtime 36/36 x3 (missing file, empty complete file, ERROR_MORE_DATA part-way, cut reader,
unconfirmed producer, startup-fault negatives; file and pipe positive controls). Mutants a-d each
FAIL (1-3). injection_guard 20/20, power_policy 27/27; every guard user builds. No host run.
